highlights.title: See your bot at work
highlights.text: While a reply is on its way, the bot's own avatar types at a little laptop, next to a line like "Ben is working on it". The words then take its place without a jump.

highlights.title: See which AI each bot runs on
highlights.text: A small mark on each bot's avatar shows its AI. When Laya picks the model, the mark shows the pick while the bot works. Hover it for the model, or why a bot can't run.

highlights.title: Find a tool in one search box
highlights.text: Type a tool's name in Add a tool or on Apps & accounts. Results come built in, through Composio, or from the public directory, and typos are fine.

fixes: Through Composio now finds any app Composio has, such as ElevenLabs, not only the popular ones.
Signing in to tool servers such as ElevenLabs now works, where it failed with "does not support automatic client registration".
